description:
This file defines the RangeException class within the ScssPhp
amespace, which extends the built-in PHP Exception class and implements the SassException interface, serving as a specific exception type for range-related errors in the SCSS PHP compiler.

classes.name: RangeException
classes.description: A custom exception class for range errors within the SCSS PHP compiler, extending PHP's built-in Exception class and implementing the SassException interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherited from PHP's Exception class; initializes the exception object. No custom constructor implementation provided.
